source_title: Super Bowl LIX: Chiefs defeat 49ers
target_title: Super Bowl LIX: 49ers defeat Chiefs
note: Binary outcome. Super Bowls cannot end in a draw; one team must win.

source_title: Premier League: Liverpool beats Arsenal
target_title: Premier League: Arsenal beats Liverpool
note: Trinary outcome. If Liverpool does NOT win, Arsenal might have won, OR it was a Draw. Therefore Source No -> Null.

source_title: Wimbledon Final: Alcaraz beats Djokovic
target_title: Wimbledon Final: Djokovic beats Alcaraz
note: Binary outcome. Tennis matches cannot end in a draw.

source_title: Tyson Fury defeats Usyk
target_title: Usyk loses to Tyson Fury
note: Semantic equivalence. Winning a fight is semantically identical to the opponent losing that fight.

source_title: Trump says 'Make America Great Again' during debate
target_title: Trump says the word 'America' during debate
note: Substring Containment. You cannot say the phrase without saying the word.

source_title: Trump says 'China' at least 10 times in speech
target_title: Trump says 'China' at least 5 times in speech
note: Numerical Subset. If he said it 10 times, he automatically satisfied the '5 times' condition.

source_title: Trump's FIRST word in the interview is 'Tremendous'
target_title: Trump's FIRST word in the interview is 'Hello'
note: Mutually Exclusive. A specific moment (t=0) can only have one value.

source_title: Trump tweets 'I am innocent'
target_title: Trump tweets 'I am guilty'
note: No logical link. While unlikely, humans can tweet contradictory things. One does not physically prevent the other.

source_title: Kamala Harris picks Roy Cooper as VP running mate
target_title: Kamala Harris picks Josh Shapiro as VP running mate
note: Exclusive Seat. A presidential candidate (traditionally) only picks one running mate. If A is picked, B is not.

source_title: Cillian Murphy cast as Doctor Doom in MCU
target_title: Robert Downey Jr. cast as Doctor Doom in MCU
note: Exclusive Role. Generally, one actor plays one specific character role. If Murphy gets it, RDJ didn't.

source_title: Zendaya cast in 'Spider-Man 4'
target_title: Tom Holland cast in 'Spider-Man 4'
note: Co-existence. Both actors can be in the same movie. One being cast does not prevent the other.

source_title: Sam Altman returns as CEO of OpenAI
target_title: Mira Murati appointed permanent CEO of OpenAI
note: Exclusive Position. There is typically only one permanent CEO at a time.

source_title: Chrome takes > 60% of global browser market share
target_title: Safari takes > 50% of global browser market share
note: Mathematical Impossibility (Zero Sum). If Chrome has >60%, there is only <40% left for everyone else combined. Safari cannot have >50%.

source_title: YouTube Ad Revenue exceeds $30 Billion
target_title: Alphabet (Google) Total Revenue exceeds $30 Billion
note: Part vs. Whole. Alphabet Revenue = YouTube + Search + Cloud, etc. If the part (YouTube) is >30B, the whole MUST be >30B.

source_title: Luka Doncic scores more points than Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
target_title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scores more points than Luka Doncic
note: Mutual Exclusion (Inequality). If A > B is true, then B > A must be false.

source_title: NBA Finals: Boston Celtics Win Championship
target_title: NBA Finals: Denver Nuggets Win Championship
note: Exclusive Championship. Only one team can win the title. If Boston wins, Denver cannot.

source_title: Manchester City wins the Premier League
target_title: Manchester City finishes 2nd in Premier League
note: Exclusive Rank. A team cannot finish 1st and 2nd simultaneously.

source_title: Bitcoin reaches $100,000 in 2025
target_title: Bitcoin reaches $150,000 in 2025
note: Numerical Supersets. If it hits $150k, it must have hit $100k. However, hitting $100k does not guarantee $150k.

source_title: Max Verstappen wins the Monaco GP
target_title: Lando Norris wins the Monaco GP
note: Exclusive Winner. Only one driver can win the race.

source_title: US Unemployment Rate drops below 3.5%
target_title: US Unemployment Rate rises above 5%
note: Numerical Exclusion. A number cannot be < 3.5 and > 5 simultaneously.

source_title: Taylor Swift announces new album 'Karma'
target_title: Taylor Swift announces a tour
note: Independence. An artist can announce an album, a tour, both, or neither. No logical force.

source_title: Coinbase stock (COIN) closes green (up) today
target_title: Coinbase stock (COIN) closes red (down) today
note: Binary Market (ignoring 0.00 change). If it is up, it is not down.

source_title: Republican Party wins the Senate
target_title: Democratic Party wins the Senate
note: Binary Control. One party must hold the majority (assuming independents caucus with one side).

source_title: Oppenheimer wins Best Picture Oscar
target_title: Barbie wins Best Picture Oscar
note: Exclusive Award. Only one movie wins Best Picture.

source_title: SpaceX Starship reaches orbit
target_title: SpaceX Starship explodes on launch pad
note: Chronological Exclusion. If it reaches orbit, it did not explode on the pad.

source_title: LeBron James scores 30+ points
target_title: LeBron James scores 20+ points
note: Numerical Subset. If he scored 30+, he definitely scored 20+.

source_title: Average Global Temperature increases by 1.5C
target_title: Average Global Temperature increases by 2.0C
note: Numerical Threshold. If it increases by 2.0, it passed 1.5. But 1.5 does not imply 2.0.

source_title: Chess World Championship: Ding Liren beats Gukesh
target_title: Chess World Championship: Gukesh beats Ding Liren
note: Trinary Outcome. In chess, a draw is a very common outcome. If A doesn't win, B might have won OR it was a draw.

source_title: UFC: McGregor knocks out Chandler
target_title: UFC: Chandler wins by decision
note: Exclusive Method/Winner. If McGregor wins by KO, Chandler cannot win by decision.

source_title: Apple acquires Disney
target_title: Disney remains an independent company
note: Binary State. You are either acquired or independent.

source_title: Federal Reserve cuts interest rates
target_title: Federal Reserve keeps interest rates unchanged
note: Exclusive Action. They cannot cut and hold simultaneously.

source_title: President Biden vetoes the bill
target_title: President Biden signs the bill into law
note: Exclusive Action. A bill is either vetoed, signed, or ignored (pocket veto). Signing negates veto.

source_title: Spotify reaches 600 Million Monthly Active Users
target_title: Spotify reaches 500 Million Monthly Active Users
note: Numerical Subset. 600M implies 500M is already achieved.

source_title: Harry Kane scores a hat-trick (3 goals)
target_title: Harry Kane scores at least 1 goal
note: Numerical Subset. You cannot score 3 without scoring 1.

source_title: Elon Musk steps down as Twitter CTO
target_title: Elon Musk sells Tesla stock
note: No Correlation. These are independent decisions.

source_title: It rains in London on Christmas Day
target_title: It snows in London on Christmas Day
note: Co-existence. It is possible (sleet/mix) or different times of day allows both rain and snow.

source_title: New York Yankees win the World Series
target_title: Los Angeles Dodgers lose the World Series
note: Conditional Dependency. This implies they are playing each other. If Yankees win, the opponent (Dodgers) loses. If Yankees win against someone else, this target is irrelevant/false. This tests specificity. Assuming a specific matchup context, it is Yes->Yes.

source_title: GTA VI released before 2026
target_title: GTA VI released in 2027
note: Temporal Exclusion. If it is out before 2026, the release date cannot be in 2027.

source_title: Mark Zuckerberg wins MMA fight against Elon Musk
target_title: Elon Musk wins MMA fight against Mark Zuckerberg
note: Binary Outcome (Fight context usually excludes draws for betting).

source_title: Nvidia becomes the most valuable company in the world
target_title: Microsoft is the most valuable company in the world
note: Exclusive Rank. There is only one #1 spot.

source_title: Billie Eilish wins 'Album of the Year'
target_title: Billie Eilish wins 'Song of the Year'
note: No Correlation. Winning one award does not guarantee or prevent winning another in a different category.

source_title: Trump selects a female Vice President
target_title: Trump selects JD Vance as Vice President
note: Attribute Exclusion. JD Vance is Male. If the VP is Female, it cannot be Vance.

source_title: NASA discovers evidence of microbial life on Mars
target_title: NASA announces Mars is sterile
note: Contradiction. Finding life contradicts the conclusion that it is sterile.

source_title: S&P 500 finishes the year up > 10%
target_title: S&P 500 finishes the year negative
note: Numerical Exclusion. >10% implies positive, so it cannot be negative.

source_title: Any country lands a human on the Moon in 2025
target_title: USA lands a human on the Moon in 2025
note: Set/Subset. If USA lands, 'Any country' is Yes. But 'Any country' Yes does not mean USA (could be China).

source_title: Candidate A receives > 50% of the vote
target_title: Candidate A goes to a runoff election
note: Rule Logic. In most systems, >50% prevents a runoff. (Assumption of standard election rules).

source_title: Actor X is cast as the next James Bond
target_title: Actor Y is cast as the next James Bond
note: Exclusive Role. Only one actor is the 'next' Bond.

source_title: Oil price rises above $100 per barrel
target_title: Gas prices at the pump increase
note: Correlation vs Causation. High probability, but strictly speaking, subsidies or taxes could intervene. However, in pure economic logic, Source Yes implies Target Yes is strong, but not absolute truth. Let's treat as Null for strict logic.

source_title: Novak Djokovic wins all 4 Grand Slams (Calendar Slam)
target_title: Novak Djokovic wins Wimbledon
note: Part/Whole. To win all 4, he MUST win Wimbledon (one of the 4).

source_title: YouTube bans crypto content
target_title: YouTube allows crypto content
note: Semantic Opposites. Banning is the negation of allowing.

source_title: Game of the Year: 'Elden Ring' wins
target_title: Game of the Year: 'God of War' wins
note: Exclusive Award.

source_title: Twitter (X) goes bankrupt
target_title: Twitter (X) IPOs again
note: Sequential Logic. While a bankrupt company *can* eventually IPO, they usually cannot do so simultaneously or in the immediate short term. However, they are not strictly logical opposites (Chapter 11 vs Liquidation). Treat as Null.

source_title: Patrick Mahomes throws 0 interceptions
target_title: Patrick Mahomes throws 2 interceptions
note: Numerical Exclusion. 0 is not 2.

source_title: A Category 5 hurricane makes landfall in Florida
target_title: A hurricane makes landfall in Florida
note: Subset. If a Cat 5 hits, a hurricane has hit.

source_title: The UK re-joins the EU
target_title: The UK remains outside the EU
note: Binary State. You are either in or out.

source_title: Bitcoin closes the day above $90k
target_title: Bitcoin closes the day below $85k
note: Numerical Gap. If >90k, it cannot be <85k. (Note: Between 85k and 90k, both are No).

source_title: MrBeast becomes the CEO of YouTube
target_title: Neal Mohan steps down as CEO of YouTube
note: Causal Chain / Exclusive Seat. For a new CEO to be appointed, the old one must leave (or move roles).

source_title: France wins the FIFA World Cup
target_title: France gets eliminated in the Group Stage
note: State Exclusion. A winner cannot have been eliminated early.

source_title: OpenAI releases GPT-5
target_title: OpenAI announces they are canceling GPT-5
note: Mutual Exclusion. You cannot release a product you cancelled (semantically, in the context of a betting timeframe).

source_title: TSLA stock splits 3-for-1
target_title: TSLA stock splits 5-for-1
note: Exclusive Event Details. A specific split event has one ratio. (Unless two separate splits happen, but market implies the 'next' split).

source_title: Joe Rogan interviews Donald Trump
target_title: Joe Rogan interviews Kamala Harris
note: Independence. He can interview both, one, or neither.

source_title: Box Office: 'Avatar 3' grosses > $2 Billion
target_title: Box Office: 'Avatar 3' grosses < $1 Billion
note: Numerical Disjoint. >2B and <1B are mutually exclusive.

source_title: New York City population increases in 2025
target_title: New York City population declines in 2025
note: Binary/Trinary (Zero change possible). If it increases, it did not decline.

source_title: Halving Event: Bitcoin block reward drops to 1.5625 BTC
target_title: Halving Event: Bitcoin block reward drops to 3.125 BTC
note: Exclusive Protocol Step. The halving schedule is fixed. It moves to one specific number, not another.
